Our most recommended things to do in Frascati

Rome: Pasta Making - Premium Wine Tasting, Roman Wine Cave

Are you searching for something special to do in Rome? Here we are. We're a Roman family who lives in Frascati and can't wait to meet you. Leave the busy Rome city to fall in love with the slow and the beauty life of locals in Frascati, the City of Wine. Your day begins with a beautiful train ride to Frascati from Rome, during which you can admire the beauty of the countryside of Rome. We will pick you up at the Frascati Railway Station and show you all the amazing corners in town visiting it like a local. Then it will be time to reach our old wine cellar, where our family started with wine production. Sip two types of our family’s best wines pairing with local meats and cheese. Next all the necessary for making pasta will be ready, so it will be your turn to get your hands dirty. Wearing apron and mixing all the ingredients together while drinking wine you’ll turned up with your own handcrafted pasta. So it will be magical to see what happened, your pasta will be cooked with your favourite Roman Sauce and that’s it! You’ll be ready to enjoy your own pasta sipping wine and relaxing at our cellar. You won’t leave our place before not have visited our wine cave where all the wine production began. We’ll visit it together showing you our oldest wine bottles and places you would never have discovered.

Pompeii Express: High-Speed Train from Rome

Meet our group leader at Termini Station in Rome and board the ultra-modern high-speed train to Naples. The lost city of Pompeii awaits after a one-hour ride and a quick transfer by coach. With your skip-the-line ticket in hand, enter the ruins and explore at your own pace. Step back in time as you wander the ancient cobblestone streets where bakeries, shops, and even hidden brothels stand as ghostly reminders of a past civilisation. Take in the tragic yet awe-inspiring plaster casts of the immortalized silent witnesses to the fury of Mt. Vesuvius during their devastating last moments alive. Feel the mystery deepen as you explore the perfectly preserved ruins of a city trapped in time. After exploring Pompeii, take some time for a leisurely lunch or explore the local shops, then return to the pre-set meeting point. Hop on our private air-conditioned coach for the short ride back to Naples before a smooth high-speed train journey back to Rome. You’ll return not just with memories, but with a sense of wonder, having experienced a fascinating world that was lost and rediscovered. As outlined above, this experience is self-guided inside the ruins at Pompeii.

From Rome: Half-Day Frascati Wine Tour with Farmhouse Lunch

Welcome in Frascati! You will start your half day trip by discovering the charming town of Frascati, known to be "the City of the Roman Golden Wine" and last but not least the City of the prestigious Renaissance Villas of the noble roman families. We suggest you to reach Frascati via a short train ride from Roma Termini station that leaves at 9:49 a.m. (or 9:54 a.m. ON SUNDAYS - or 8:54 a.m. ON SATURDAYS) directed to FRASCATI station, and you will meet your host right outside the entrance of Frascati station in the middle of the square! If you prefer, you can also reach the meeting point with your own car or taxi/Uber! START OF THE EXPERIENCE IN FRASCATI! You will tour the town first, to discover why Frascati had a key role in the history and in the wine tradition of the Eternal City. You will enjoy the different areas of the historic center, and you will taste local wine paired with a traditional snack! You will then be transferred to our family's ancient Wine Farmhouse, only a few minutes distant from the town. You will enjoy a family run ancient Wine Farmhouse, located in the valleys of the Frascati Wine, only 7 minutes distant from the town of Frascati. Here the family has cultivated vineyards and olive trees for nine generations, and produced jug wine directly in the old cellar. The 9th generation family farmhouse is now a sort of cozy "Frascati Wine Museum" surrounded by vineyards and olive groves, where the family spread the culture of local good wines and good food. You will have a guided visit and tasting of 3 Boutique Wines and EVO Oil, along with a traditional LUNCH at the family farmhouse! At the end of the experience, you will be transferred back in town where you will take the return train from the city center to Rome!

Countryside Wine Tasting with Local Family & Food Pairing

Escape Rome for a relaxed private wine experience in the hills of the Castelli Romani. Your driver will collect you from an eligible location in Rome and take you through the countryside to a historic Frascati wine estate surrounded by vineyards. On arrival, meet your winery host and discover the estate’s centuries-old connection with local winemaking. Explore the historic property, including its 17th-century architecture and ancient underground caverns lined with French oak barrels. Learn how winemaking traditions have developed in the Frascati region from Roman times to the present day. After the visit, sit down for a guided tasting of specially selected estate wines. Enjoy the wines alongside local food pairings, freshly baked bread and extra virgin olive oil while your host explains the characteristics of each selection. The private format gives you time to ask questions and enjoy the setting with your own party. At the end of the experience, your driver will take you comfortably back to Rome.

From Rome: Pasta Masterclass & Wine Tour in the Vineyard

You can join us with a very quick connection from the city center of Rome! Once arrived in Frascati, a member of our team will welcome you! We will transfer you to our family Wine Farmhouse with a 5 minutes drive from the Frascati station, to enjoy a fun and informative pasta masterclass with our Chef! The Pasta Masterclass! Once you wear your apron, our Chef will teach you how to prepare from scratch nr. 3 of the traditional local pasta varieties, including “Ravioli” stuffed with the local ingredients, “Fettuccine” and “Maltagliati“, as well as some of the secrets of the local pasta making tradition! You will learn the original pasta recipe of our land, including many secret and tips that our Chef learnt from his Grandma! Wine Tasting and Farmhouse tour… After the class, you will enjoy a guided wine tasting of the boutique wines of the family production: the Frascati Superiore DOCG white wine varieties, and the Vagnolo IGP red wine 100% Cesanese grapes. The wines will be matched with the Extra Virgin Olive Oil produced by the family and with cheese and Wine Jam. After the tastings, we will take you on a tour across the old vineyards to travel into the past of the winemaking and to show you the same old farming techniques that our family has been adopting for centuries. The Minardi Wine Farmhouse is now a sort of family-run “Frascati Wine Museum” surrounded by ancient vineyards and olive groves. Time for Lunch… and more Wine! We will enjoy a nice lunch prepared by our Chef, including a rich appetizer with several varieties of local seasonal food, and of course the three Pastas that you have prepared during the class! Artisanal Frascati wine, White Wine and water are also included in the lunch! The Chef lunch can also be Vegetarian/Vegan/Gluten free friendly, you will just let us know when you book the experience! At the end of the experience we will drive you back in Frascati center, where you will be able to have a look at the cute town of Frascati and take the train back to Rome (there is one train every hour). We promise you that this will be a one of a kind experience on the charming hills surrounding the Eternal City! SUGGESTIONS ON HOW TO REACH THE MEETING POINT OF THE EXPERIENCE: We suggest you to catch the train in Rome Termini Station at 9:49 a.m. (9:54 am on Sundays only) towards Frascati (this is a short 20 minutes comfortable train ride! ) or if you prefer to come with your own car or taxi/uber, you will let us know after the booking and we will provide you with meeting point time and address! IMPORTANT LOGISTICS SUGGESTIONS for SATURDAYS only: Only on Saturdays, we suggest you to take the train from Rome Termini station at 10:14am directed to the second frascati station called TOR VERGATA station (the main destination of this train is either Cassino or Frosinone on the billboard); tickets for TOR VERGATA (cost eur 1,50) also in advance online (www.trenitalia.com)

From Rome: Private Castelli Romani Wine Tasting Tour

Escape the busy streets of Rome and enjoy a relaxing journey into the scenic hills of the Castelli Romani, one of Italy’s most celebrated wine regions. With private transportation from your hotel, you’ll travel comfortably through the countryside to reach a historic winery known for its long-standing winemaking traditions. This experience lasts a total of 3 hours, including: 45 minutes transfer from Rome to the winery, 1 hour and 30 minutes wine tasting experience , 45 minutes transfer back to Rome Upon arrival, you’ll be welcomed at a beautiful 17th-century estate surrounded by rolling vineyards stretching across 160 acres. This family-owned winery, one of the oldest in the region, blends history, tradition, and passion for wine in a truly authentic setting. Your experience begins with a guided walk through the estate’s ancient underground cellars, including fascinating caverns dating back to Roman times. Here, among oak barrels and stone walls, you’ll learn about traditional winemaking techniques passed down through generations. Your knowledgeable guide will share stories about the region’s deep connection to wine — from ancient Roman traditions to modern production methods. After the visit, sit back and enjoy a carefully curated wine tasting featuring a selection of the estate’s finest wines. Each glass is paired with freshly baked bread, locally produced olive oil, and delicious regional specialties, allowing you to fully savor the authentic flavors of the Italian countryside. This private experience allows you to relax, ask questions, and fully enjoy the atmosphere at a comfortable pace. Whether you are a wine enthusiast or simply looking for a memorable cultural escape, this tour offers the perfect combination of history, taste, and beautiful scenery. At the end of your experience, you’ll return comfortably to Rome, bringing with you wonderful memories and a deeper appreciation of Italian wine and tradition.

Frascati Wine Road from Rome: Tasting & Lunch

Upon arrival in Frascati begin your tour at a locally renowned 16th-century farmhouse, vineyard, and winery where you’ll enjoy a guided visit by the owners, proud winemakers for multiple generations. Tour the wine cellar and Roman-era caves, then see how age-old winemaking traditions have been maintained through the years and incorporated into the modern production of today’s highly sought-after DOCG wines (don’t worry, you’ll even learn what all those initials mean!). After a walk through the vineyard, relax and take in the unforgettable view of the rolling hills and Rome in the background while enjoying a guided tasting of three wines; Frascati Superiore, Red Vagnolo, and Sweet Cannellino. Each wine is described in detail and accompanied by delectable local extra virgin olive oil and baked goods from the local bakery. After bidding a reluctant farewell to the winery, return to historic Frascati for a walking tour of the local shops and botteghe. Here you’ll taste celebrated local delicacies such as roasted pork (porchetta), focaccia, biscotti — just out of the antique wood-fired oven — and jug wine from the oldest tavern in town to name a few. Be sure to save room for lunch (and of course, more wine) in a hand-picked local trattoria. After your meal, the train station is just a few steps away for your return to Rome.

Rome Countryside: Wine Tasting Tour with Private Driver

Experience the art of Italian winemaking in Rome, where history meets flavor. Join a guided wine tasting tour to sample a variety of exceptional wines paired with local delicacies. Your tour will typically be led by an experienced sommelier or local wine expert who will introduce you to the rich history of Italian wines, the regions they come from, and the distinct characteristics of each varietal. To enhance the tasting experience, enjoy a selection of local cheeses, cured meats, olives, and artisanal breads that are carefully chosen to complement the wines. Engage with the sommelier and fellow participants as you learn about the winemaking process, tasting techniques, and the significance of terroir. Feel free to ask questions and share your preferences! In addition to tasting wine, you’ll gain insights into Italian culture, customs associated with wine, and tips on how to choose and enjoy wine in Italy. A wine tasting tour in Rome is not just about sampling delicious wines; it's a culinary journey that immerses you in the tradition and passion of Italian winemaking. Whether you're a wine enthusiast or a casual drinker, this experience is sure to enhance your visit to the Eternal City.

From Rome: Wine Tour & Farmhouse Lunch in the Vineyard

Welcome in Frascati! You will be recommended to reach Frascati via a short and comfortable train ride from Roma termini station (See train instructions at the end of this paragraph), or you will opt to reach the farmhouse with your own car, taxi or Uber! You will enjoy a convivial experience in a family-run ancient Wine Farmhouse, located in the valleys of the Frascati Wine, only 7 minutes distant from the town of Frascati. Here the family has cultivated vineyards and olive trees for nine generations, and produced jug wine directly in the old cellar. The farmhouse is now a sort of "Frascati Wine Museum" surrounded by vineyards and olive groves, where the family spread the culture of local good wines and good food. You will have a guided visit around the vineyard to enjoy beautiful landscapes and you will enjoy a guided tasting of 3 Boutique Wines and EVO Oil paired with italian snacks, followed by a traditional LUNCH prepared by the Chef directly at the family farmhouse! At the end of the experience, you will be transferred back in town where you will take the return train from the city center to Rome! The WINE TASTING & FARMHOUSE LUNCH experience will start at 12:00 at the Farmhouse! SUGGESTIONS ON HOW TO REACH THE MEETING POINT OF THE EXPERIENCE: IF YOU COME BY TRAIN: We recommend taking the 9:49 a.m. train (or ONLY ON SUNDAYS train is at 9.54 a.m. - or ONLY ON SATURDAYS train is at 8.54 a.m.) from Roma Termini station to Frascati station, a quick and comfortable 24 minutes ride! Once you arrive at Frascati station at 10:20 a.m. (while ON SATURDAYS you arrive in Frascati at 9:24 a.m.), feel free to take a leisurely stroll through the historic city center or unwind at one of the charming local bars, like “Fondi” or “Belvedere” in Piazza Roma, while waiting for our pickup. Frascati’s center is home to a beautiful Baroque cathedral that’s well worth a visit! The meeting point for our pick up (only for those arriving by train) will be in front of the Frascati train station at 11:45am! (piazzale Sandro Pertini, 00044 Frascati), where we will pick you up with a quick 8 minute drive to go to the Farmhouse and start the experience ! INSTRUCTIONS FOR SATURDAYS ONLY (times are different) IF YOU COME BY by Car, Taxi or Uber we will meet directly at Minardi Frascati Winery (on google maps, via san marco 00044 Frascati) at 12:00. Please be sure to inform us in advance in case you arrive with your car/taxi/Uber, you can contact us by email at info@minardifrascatiwinery.com or by WhatsApp/SMS at +39 349 287 8141, thank you! IF YOU COME BY TRAIN: On Saturdays only, you can arrive in Frascati center directly with the early train at 8:54am from Roma Termini to FRASCATI station. In this case, We will have our meeting point in Frascati town in the square of the central station (piazzale Sandro Pertini 00044 Frascati) at 11:45 a.m.! We promise you a truly unique experience in the enchanting hills surrounding the Eternal City!

Frascati: Half Day Wine Tour

Our Classic Half-Day Wine Tour is an easy 30 minute train ride from Rome but worlds away from the crowds of the city! It is available EVERY DAY beginning in the morning and ending after lunch. It includes a tour and tasting at a historic 16th century family vineyard in the Frascati countryside, a guided tour of Frascati, and lunch at a local Osteria. You'll meet your driver in front of the Frascati Train Station (or Tor Vergata station on Saturdays) The meeting times are listed below: Monday-Friday at Frascati Train Station at 10:19 AM Saturday at Tor Vergata Train Station at 10:32 AM Sunday at Frascati Train Station at 10:24 AM You will tour the beautiful artisanal Frascati vineyard and 16th century farmhouse and winery accompanied by the winemaker. Learn about how the artisanal winemaking tradition has been kept alive by a devotion to traditional winemaking techniques, incorporated into the production of modern DOCG wines. Explore a deep wine cave which dates back to the times of Ancient Rome. Taste three boutique wines; Frascati Superiore DOCG, Roma Red IGT and Sweet Cannellino DOCG. Each wine is described in detail and is accompanied by freshly baked goods picked up from the bakery in the center of town. Sit and relax while sipping your wine in a beautiful setting with amazing views of Rome in the distance. After the tour at the winery uou will return to town to learn about the history of Frascati while tasting local products like slow-roasted pork and Frascati jug wine. Meet local artisans and shop owners who are eager to share their stories. Feel like a local while accompanied by your guide who lives in Frascati and knows everybody in town! Blend in with the locals. Meet the bakers, the butchers, and the farmers selling vegetables from their fields. Their stalls are full of items such as fresh fruit, vegetables, cheeses, cured meats, balsamic vinegar, sun dried tomatoes, olives and many other Italian food specialties. You will enjoy a wonderful traditional lunch at a local osteria. Lunch begins with local cheeses, vegetables & different salumi and is followed by fresh homemade pasta with seasonal sauces. The meal is also served with delicious house wine from the restaurant. You should finish lunch by about 3-3:30PM, you are free to leave and explore Frascati on your own once you are finished eating. Trains return to Rome every hour at :36 until 9:36PM (every other hour on Sundays).

Rome E-Bike Tour: Frascati Vineyard & Wine Tasting Adventure
5 out of 5 stars
M
Merryl Sep 28, 2026
A fun way to explore a different side of Rome! 🚲 The tour started in Rome, where we met our guide and got our bikes before making our way to the train station. From there, we took the train out to Frascati. Once we arrived, our guide gave us a little tour of the town before we made our way up to a beautiful viewpoint overlooking Rome and the surrounding countryside. The views were spectacular and made the whole journey worthwhile. The guide was knowledgeable, friendly and helpful throughout, and it was lovely to learn more about the area and experience a part of the Italian countryside that you might not otherwise get to see on a typical trip to Rome. And, of course, the tour ended with a delicious tasting of local products, including salami, porchetta and wine. 🍷 The perfect way to finish the day! Overall, it was such a unique day trip and a great option for anyone looking to do something active while experiencing a different side of Italy beyond the usual Rome attractions.
